_doc: Funders that must NEVER make a holder look like a Sybil. A CEX hot wallet is the first funder of thousands of unrelated people, so a shared-funder cluster pointing here is a crowd, not a bundle. This is the belt to the corroboration braces (uniform-amount / burner-funder tests in coin.ts): those catch unlisted exchanges too, this just spares the RPC. Grow it with scripts/harvest-cex-funders.ts (Solscan/label sources). Only add an address with a checkable source — a wrong entry here silently blinds the detector.
